keyEvents.text: Goal! Arsenal 1, Borussia Dortmund 0. Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) right footed shot from outside the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Noni Madueke.
First Half ends, Arsenal 1, Borussia Dortmund 0.
Goal! Arsenal 1, Borussia Dortmund 1. Maximilian Beier (Borussia Dortmund) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Joane Gadou.
Substitution, Borussia Dortmund. Konstantinos Karetsas replaces Maximilian Beier.
Substitution, Borussia Dortmund. Serhou Guirassy replaces Fábio Silva.
Substitution, Arsenal. Eberechi Eze replaces Christos Tzolis.
Substitution, Arsenal. Jurriën Timber replaces Ben White.
Substitution, Arsenal. Bruno Guimarães replaces Myles Lewis-Skelly.
Substitution, Borussia Dortmund. Marcel Sabitzer replaces Jobe Bellingham.
Delay in match because of an injury Gregor Kobel (Borussia Dortmund).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Arsenal. Mikel Merino replaces Viktor Gyökeres.
Substitution, Borussia Dortmund. Filippo Mane replaces Joane Gadou.
Second Half ends, Arsenal 1, Borussia Dortmund 1.
